title: 完美分割的方案数
summary: 把数字字符串恰分成 k 段，每段长度至少 minLength，且首位是质数数字、末位是非质数数字，统计方案数并取模。
insight: 合法切点必须位于“非质数数字之后、质数数字之前”（首尾另算）。逐段 DP 时扫描右端点，用滚动前缀和汇总所有距离当前端点至少 minLength 的上一层合法切点。
pitfalls: 必须恰好分成 k 段
首字符和末字符不满足条件时直接无解
切点距离要满足最小段长

solutions.title: 分段动态规划与滚动前缀和
solutions.idea: dp[position] 表示前若干段恰在 position 结束的方案数。
steps: 先检查首位为质数且末位非质数
重复 k 轮：扫描 end=1..n，把 start=end-minLength 对应的上一层 dp 加入 running
若 end 是合法切点，则 next[end]=running

code.java: class Solution { private static final int MOD=1_000_000_007;private String text;private boolean prime(char digit){return digit=='2'||digit=='3'||digit=='5'||digit=='7';}private boolean boundary(int position){return position==0||position==text.length()||!prime(text.charAt(position-1))&&prime(text.charAt(position));}public int beautifulPartitions(String s,int k,int minLength){text=s;int n=s.length();if(!prime(s.charAt(0))||prime(s.charAt(n-1)))return 0;long[] dp=new long[n+1];dp[0]=1;for(int part=0;part<k;part++){long[] next=new long[n+1];long running=0;for(int end=1;end<=n;end++){int start=end-minLength;if(start>=0&&boundary(start))running=(running+dp[start])%MOD;if(boundary(end))next[end]=running;}dp=next;}return (int)dp[n];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun prime(digit:Char)=digit=='2'||digit=='3'||digit=='5'||digit=='7';fun beautifulPartitions(s:String,k:Int,minLength:Int):Int{val n=s.length;val mod=1_000_000_007L;if(!prime(s[0])||prime(s[n-1]))return 0;fun boundary(position:Int):Boolean{return position==0||position==n||(!prime(s[position-1])&&prime(s[position]))};var dp=LongArray(n+1);dp[0]=1;repeat(k){val next=LongArray(n+1);var running=0L;for(end in 1..n){val start=end-minLength;if(start>=0&&boundary(start))running=(running+dp[start])%mod;if(boundary(end))next[end]=running};dp=next};return dp[n].toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { static const int MOD=1'000'000'007;bool prime(char digit){return digit=='2'||digit=='3'||digit=='5'||digit=='7';}public:int beautifulPartitions(string s,int k,int minLength){int n=s.size();if(!prime(s[0])||prime(s[n-1]))return 0;auto boundary=[&](int position){return position==0||position==n||(!prime(s[position-1])&&prime(s[position]));};vector<long long> dp(n+1);dp[0]=1;while(k--){vector<long long> next(n+1);long long running=0;for(int end=1;end<=n;++end){int start=end-minLength;if(start>=0&&boundary(start))running=(running+dp[start])%MOD;if(boundary(end))next[end]=running;}dp.swap(next);}return dp[n];} };
